headline: Sanghvi Movers releases investor presentation
hook: Routine quarterly slide deck now available
summary: Sanghvi Movers Limited has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. Such filings typically outline operational highlights, fleet details, and strategic outlook for the company. Retail investors can review the presentation to assess asset utilization and growth plans. The filing provides standardized public disclosures without immediate earnings surprises.
why_it_matters: Provides official insight into asset deployment and fleet performance.

headline: Sanghvi Movers appoints Aditya Bhartia as Independent Director
hook: New independent director joins Sanghi Movers
summary: Sanghvi Movers has announced the appointment of Mr. Aditya Bhartia as an Independent Director of the company, effective November 02, 2026. Independent directors play a key governance role on corporate boards by providing unbiased oversight. For retail investors, board changes are routine corporate governance updates that generally have no immediate impact on stock price or daily operations.
whats_next: Board meetings or AGM involving the new director
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Sanghvi Movers reports quarterly financial results
hook: Standalone and consolidated performance declared for September
summary: Sanghvi Movers has announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The board approved these results during its latest meeting. Retail investors can review the earnings data to assess the company's operational performance and revenue growth for the period.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides Sanghvi Movers stock price direction
